observations.temple_of_ikov: Pick up the boots in the dark cellar before the bridge, search for ice arrows, check Thieving at the trap lever and pass Lesarkus. The two allegiance routes share one completion award. Historian Minas provides five additional kudos.
observations.mage_arena_i: The Ardougne approach uses the lever and slashable webs. The duel requires 60 Magic to start. The modeled fight uses a staff of air and a reserve of Fire Blast runes. The first cape and staff are separate claims.
observations.specimens: Five exhibit finds give ten kudos each. Cleaning has variable time and a success check per find. The clean necklace teaches the enchantment and gives no kudos.
observations.pendant: Level-3 Enchant creates a five-charge pendant. The Digsite arrival registers the diary task. Attune the island destination separately at the House on the Hill after Bone Voyage.
observations.bone_voyage: The five finds and the existing quiz and reports can reach the kudos gate. A walk from Hosidius connects the guild gate, and the self-funded route can buy the sealegs potion ingredients.
